mapper.select: SELECT btt.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, btt.HAPPEN_DATE as hanppenDate, btt.BOOK_DATE as bookDate, btt.BOOKSET_DATE as booksetDate, bb.STANDARD_CCY as standardCcy, bb.BOOKSET_NAME as booksetName, bb.BOOKSET_FULLNAME as booksetFullname, bb.ACCT_MODE as acctMode, bb.BOK_SPEC_MODE as bokSpecMode, bb.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID as acctSubjectId, bbe.PARAM_VALUE as valDecDigits, bbe2.PARAM_VALUE as valDecType, bbe3.PARAM_VALUE as pyeildDecDigits, bbe.REMARK as remark, fin.FINPROD_NAME as finprodName, BL.LAYERING_ID as layeringId FROM BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO btt LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bb ON bb.BOOKSET_ID = btt.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_EXT bbe ON bbe.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID AND bbe.PARAM_CODE = 'VAL_DEC_DIGITS' LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_EXT bbe2 ON bbe2.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID AND bbe2.PARAM_CODE = 'VAL_DEC_TYPE' LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_EXT bbe3 ON bbe3.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID AND bbe3.PARAM_CODE = #{pyeildCode} LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_DATE bbd ON bbd.BOOKSET_ID = btt.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fin ON fin.FINPROD_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_ACCT_LAYERING_INFO BL ON BL.BUSI_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID AND BL.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE = bb.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE WHERE btt.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND btt.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE} AND btt.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE} AND btt.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE} AND btt.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND btt.IS_SUB_BOOKSET = #{IS_SUB_BOOKSET}

SELECT bs.BOOKSET_ID, bs.SUBJECT_NO, bs.SUBJECT_NAME, bs.FSUBJECT_ID, bs.SUBJECT_TYPE, bs.SUBJECT_LEVEL FROM BOK_SUBJECT bs,BOK_BOOKSET bb WHERE bb.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND bs.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL

SELECT VBB.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, VBT.BOOKSET_NAME as booksetName, VBB.BALANCE_DATE as bookDate, VBB.SUBJECT_NO as subjectNo, VBS.SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName, VBB.O_CCY as oCcy, VBB.NUM_AMT as numAmt, VBB.O_AMT as oAmt, VBB.B_AMT as bAmt FROM BOK_BALANCE VBB
LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET VBT ON VBB.BOOKSET_ID = VBT.BOOKSET_ID
LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT VBS ON VBT.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL = VBS.BOOKSET_ID AND VBB.SUBJECT_NO = VBS.SUBJECT_NO
WHERE VBB.BALANCE_DATE = #{bookDate} AND VBB.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND VBS.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE = #{baseSubjectNature00} AND VBB.SUBJECT_LEVEL = '1' ORDER BY VBB.BOOKSET_ID,VBB.SUBJECT_NO,VBB.O_CCY

SELECT VBB.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, VBT.BOOKSET_NAME as booksetName, VBB.BALANCE_DATE as bookDate, VBB.SUBJECT_NO as subjectNo, VBS.SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName, VBB.O_CCY as oCcy, VBB.NUM_AMT as numAmt,
decode(VBB.BAL_FLAG, 'C', VBB.O_AMT, -VBB.O_AMT) oAmt, decode(VBB.BAL_FLAG, 'C', VBB.B_AMT, -VBB.B_AMT) bAmt, VBS.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE FROM BOK_BALANCE VBB
LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET VBT ON VBB.BOOKSET_ID = VBT.BOOKSET_ID
LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT VBS ON VBT.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL = VBS.BOOKSET_ID AND VBB.SUBJECT_NO = VBS.SUBJECT_NO
WHERE VBB.BALANCE_DATE = #{bookDate} AND VBB.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND VBS.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE IN (#{baseSubjectNature01},#{baseSubjectNature02}) AND VBB.SUBJECT_LEVEL = '3' ORDER BY VBB.BOOKSET_ID,VBB.SUBJECT_NO,VBB.O_CCY
mapper.delete: delete from BOK_VAL_TABLE_DATA where VAL_DATE = #{valDate} and BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(A.B_HAPPEN_AMT * DECODE(A.CD_FLAG,'C',1,-1)) FROM BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT A, BOK_ACCT_LAYERING_INFO B, BOK_BOOKSET C WHERE A.BOK_DETAIL_ID = B.BOK_DETAIL_ID AND A.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID AND A.BOOKSET_ID = C.BOOKSET_ID AND A.SUBJECT_NO = '22060201' AND A.TABLE_ID = '8105' AND A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND A.BOOK_DATE = #{bookDate} AND C.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{acctSubjectId}
